meta.title: 빛뜰 미술관
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (빛뜰 미술관, a museum of glass art opening behind a wall of stained glass (fictional museum)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 빛뜰 미술관, a museum of glass art opening behind a wall of stained glass (fictional museum)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Jewel glass against dark stone: cobalt #2856A8 and sky #4A8CD0, ruby #B8243A, amber #E8A33C and gold #F4CD55, emerald #2E8B57 and leaf #6DB04B, violet #7A4DA8, clear #D6E6EA, lead #26262B; walls and floor near black #16151B so the glass carries all the light; the time of day tints it (cool at nine, white at noon, amber at six).
rationale.type: Grandiflora One, an elegant high-contrast display face with an art-nouveau swing, for the name and the line; Gowun Batang for everything small.
rationale.motion: Light is the motion: the lead is drawn out from the sun, then the pieces light in the same order; a brighter band of sun slides across the glass; the window lies on the floor as coloured light that drifts as the sun moves, with dust in the shafts; the evening warms the colour.
rationale.sound: Ambient at 80 BPM in F lydian on recorded instruments (VCSL and VSCO 2 CE, CC0): a quiet pipe organ bed, hand chimes for the motion, tubular bells on top, a flute hook, a soft kick and shaker; chimes and swells for the pieces lighting, a reveal for the name.
rationale.visuals: All code: a Voronoi tessellation clipped to an arched frame with its seeds placed in pairs on each figure's outline (the sun, three flowers, leaves, a bird), so the lead follows the drawing; pieces lit by a gradient from a bright centre with a per-piece shade and a blurred copy added for the glow; the floor light is the same pieces through a skew; a vase, a bowl and a lampshade made of the window's pieces.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the light is enough.
